# SSHGate W2 false-positive corpus (read-intent commands).
#
# Format: <EXPECTED>\t<cmd> — identical to classifier-corpus.txt, so loadCorpus
# is reused verbatim. `#`/blank lines are ignored; split on the FIRST tab.
#
# Every row is a READ-INTENT command by construction. Exactly 13 rows are
# labeled WRITE — the designated by-design residual (Appendix B of the spec):
# package-manager queries, openssl, cloud CLIs beyond kubectl, and one
# command-substitution row. The other 148 are READ. Total = 161.
# After the §2-§5 fixes land, Classify must match every label => 13/161 = 8.1%.

# --- C-1: sed /e substring FPs (W2-3c) — now READ ---
READ	sed 's/warn/err/' /var/log/syslog
READ	sed 's/error/warn/' app.log
READ	sed -n '/error/p' app.log
READ	sed '/error/d' app.log
READ	sed 's/end$//' f
READ	sed 's|/etc|/opt|' f
READ	sed 's/a\/e/b/' f

# --- C-2: read tools now allowlisted (W2-3a) — READ ---
READ	jq -r '.status' response.json
READ	cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd
READ	tr -d '\0'
READ	column -t /etc/fstab
READ	zgrep error /var/log/syslog.2.gz
READ	zcat /var/log/syslog.1.gz
READ	nl /etc/passwd
READ	tac /var/log/syslog
READ	rev /etc/hostname
READ	md5sum /etc/hosts
READ	sha256sum /usr/bin/ls
READ	cksum /etc/hostname
READ	b2sum /etc/hosts
READ	realpath /usr/bin/python
READ	basename /usr/local/bin/foo
READ	dirname /usr/local/bin/foo
READ	lscpu
READ	lsblk
READ	nproc
READ	vmstat 1 1
READ	iostat -x 1 1
READ	mpstat
READ	getent passwd root
READ	sysctl kernel.hostname
READ	sysctl -n vm.swappiness
READ	sysctl -a
READ	mount
READ	ulimit -a
READ	crontab -l
READ	command -v docker
READ	type ls
READ	test -f /etc/hosts
READ	[ -d /var/log ]
READ	watch -n 5 df -h
READ	history
# version probes (READ per decision #1)
READ	node --version
READ	node -v
READ	python3 --version
READ	python3 -V
READ	perl -v
READ	ruby --version

# --- C-2 residual (out of scope) — WRITE by design ---
WRITE	apt list --installed
WRITE	dpkg -l
WRITE	rpm -qa
WRITE	pip list
WRITE	npm ls
WRITE	openssl x509 -noout -text -in /etc/ssl/cert.pem
WRITE	openssl s_client -connect example.com:443

# --- C-5: stderr-only redirects (W2-3d + B1) — READ ---
READ	ls /nonexistent 2>&1
READ	find / -name '*.pid' 2>/dev/null
READ	docker logs app 2>&1
READ	cat /etc/hosts 2>&-
READ	journalctl -u nginx 2>/dev/null
READ	df -h 2>&1

# --- C-6 residual: command substitution — WRITE by design ---
WRITE	grep "$(hostname)" /etc/hosts
